entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Neither. It's just not going to be used. My wife had an emergency and was in the hospital. The whole situation meant she had to have surgery and can't train for her next deployment. We just need to return it.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope she's recovering well. Let me just pull up your order information and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I see the order was delivered about 20 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy...
Yes, it looks like you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I can process this for a full refund for you right now.
Okay, great. So you're sending the label?
Yes, I've just approved it. The prepaid return label is on its way to your email as we speak. You can expect to see the refund processed once we receive the item back at our warehouse.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Again, I wish your wife a speedy recovery. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
